    The studio

    A gallery that happens to teach.

    We built the page we wished we had when we started teaching: quiet type, real work, and a room that opens in one click.

    Made by people who make things.

    Folio is a demonstration template, which means every number here is invented. What is not invented is the argument: for a visual instructor, the page is the portfolio, and the portfolio is the pitch.

    So the page is white, the rules are hairlines, and colour is reserved for the one shape that means “start”: a lime pill with navy on it.

    • One page, one decision
    • Illustration in brand colours only
    • Motion that never delays a tap
